source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC Web UI -> Click "Sensor" from the menu bar.
2. Click "Sensor detail" to check each sensor. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
3. Jam FAN by a cable ties and check BMC SEL and health LED.
4. Recover and check the FAN status.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Sensor value should be OK in the reasonable range.
2. Sensor value is same as ipmi sdr command and web ui
3. BMC should record the error message and health LED shoule be amber when trigger error.
4. FAN status should recover after remove the cable ties.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Jam System FAN 1~N Status: jamming a physical fan (1~N) to force a failed-FAN SEL/behaviour requires a person physically stopping the fan rotor. Agent cannot jam a fan over SSH.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator stops the fan and captures the SEL/behaviour (alarm, LED); agent cannot produce this physically.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: jamming a fan can overheat the system or damage the motor; physical human action only.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: PACKAGE / CHANGED; physical setup plus assistable evidence.

original_test_intent: Force each mapped system fan into a failed state, verify UI/IPMI agreement, SEL and amber health indication, then release it and prove normal recovery.
original_method: An engineer applies/removes a physical fan obstruction while BMC sensor, SEL and LED evidence is collected.
manual_activity: Engineer applies/removes the safe fixture and observes the LED; automation can collect every mapped fan's UI/IPMI/SEL/recovery evidence.
safety_requirements: Do not use cable ties against a rotating fan unless explicitly approved.
Maintain independent thermal monitoring and immediate release.
Stop on cooling/thermal fault; no automatic retry.
Verify free rotation and automatic control after release.
agent_execution_scope: Capture WebUI export, IPMI RPM/status, temperatures, SEL and recovery around each engineer action.
Do not touch the fan or claim LED observation.
engineer_actions: Approve/apply/remove fixture and observe physical indicators.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies manual stimulus but omits the automatable evidence scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted read-only BMC telemetry around the approved physical fault.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map and fault one fan at a time using an approved fixture, time-correlate RPM/thermal/SEL/LED, release immediately and verify automatic recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds bounded fixture and abort/restore controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retains all mapped fans and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fan obstruction can damage hardware or cause overheating.

project_override_considerations: Actual N and any alternate fault injector must be recorded; do not claim untested fans.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently describe a physical fan-fault/recovery test; missing N and fixture are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Manual fault setup plus automated monitoring is PARTIAL under locked V3.1, not blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Expands NO into agent-assisted evidence without claiming physical action.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds fixture safety and no-retry boundary.

review_improvement: Makes each fan fault bounded, reversible and independently evidenced.
independent_technical_reasoning: The physical jam is manual preparation, but the core state transition, event correlation and recovery capture are machine-observable once safety inputs are approved.
